title: AI Adoption & Enablement Manager (Part Time)
jobDescription:
Required Qualification

- 12+ years of professional experience.
- Meaningful experience in Finance Operations, Business Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services, BPO or a comparable operational environment.
- Strong understanding of administrative and transactional finance processes; experience across areas such as AP, AR, billing, collections, cash application, reconciliations and reporting is highly desirable.
- Strong hands-on experience using Generative AI tools, particularly Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, in a business environment.
- Demonstrated ability to identify practical AI use cases and translate technology into improvements in day-to-day work.
- Strong training, facilitation, coaching, presentation and stakeholder-engagement capabilities.
- Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Ability and willingness to work flexible shifts when required to engage teams across global time zones.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote / work-from-home environment.

Preferred Qualification

Preferred / Advantageous
- Experience leading technology adoption, change management, process improvement or transformation initiatives.
- Experience in a global shared-services, professional-services, insurance, financial-services or business-services organization.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate or Power Platform.
- Understanding of AI agents and workflow automation.
- Lean, Six Sigma, process-improvement or change-management experience/certification.
- Experience developing learning programs, communities of practice or champion networks.
- Understanding of responsible AI, data security and appropriate enterprise use of Generative AI.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- Passionate and genuinely curious about Generative AI and how it can transform work.
- A sophisticated hands-on user of ChatGPT, Copilot and related tools - not someone whose knowledge is primarily theoretical.
- Understands business processes and operational realities, not just technology.
- Can quickly understand someone s work and identify realistic opportunities where AI can help.
- Can turn complex AI capabilities into simple, compelling and practical examples.
- An excellent presenter, facilitator and coach who can engage both frontline employees and senior executives.
- Comfortable influencing people without direct authority.
- Commercially minded and focused on measurable outcomes.
- Self-motivated, adaptable and effective in a remote, global working environment.
- Continuously experiments, learns and stays current as AI capabilities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Adoption Practical Enablement
- Lead practical adoption of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and other approved Generative AI tools across global teams.
- Deliver engaging, hands-on workshops, demonstrations, learning sessions, office hours and individual coaching.
- Teach employees how to use AI effectively for their actual work rather than relying on generic AI examples.
- Develop role-based prompting techniques, reusable prompts, templates, workflows and practical guidance.
- Help employees progress from basic AI usage to integrating AI into their normal day-to-day work.
- Make Generative AI understandable and accessible to employees with different levels of technical proficiency.

2. Finance, Operations Shared Services Use Cases
Work directly with business teams to identify and implement practical AI opportunities across activities such as:
- Accounts Payable and invoice-related activities
- Accounts Receivable, collections and cash application
- Billing and invoicing
- Reconciliations and data validation
- Financial and operational reporting
- Administrative and shared-services activities
- Email drafting, summarization and communication management
- Meeting preparation, notes and follow-up actions
- Research, information synthesis and document review
- Standard operating procedures, process documentation and knowledge management
- Process analysis, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
The individual must understand the underlying process and business objective before recommending an AI solution.

3. Use-Case Discovery Scaling
- Partner with teams to discover high-value AI opportunities and prioritize them based on practicality and business impact.
- Convert business problems into practical Copilot, ChatGPT or AI-enabled approaches that employees can use themselves.
- Build and maintain a reusable library of proven AI use cases, prompts, playbooks and examples.
- Develop function-specific AI playbooks for Finance, Operations, Shared Services and other corporate functions.
- Identify successful practices in one team or region and scale them across the global organization.
- Partner with technology or automation teams when a use case requires a more advanced solution, workflow or agent.

4. Global Engagement Facilitation
- Work with employees and leaders across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions.
- Operate flexibly across shifts and time zones to support a global workforce.
- Build credibility with both operational employees and senior business leaders.
- Adapt communication, examples and facilitation style for different cultures, functions and levels of AI maturity.
- Create and support a global network of AI champions or power users who can reinforce adoption locally.
- Communicate AI concepts in simple business language and inspire employees to experiment responsibly.

5. Change Management Continuous Improvement
- Drive behavioral change so that employees move from learning about AI to consistently using it to improve their work.
- Identify barriers to adoption and develop practical interventions to address them.
- Create communications, learning journeys and engagement activities that sustain adoption.
- Capture and communicate success stories that demonstrate tangible business value.
- Bring a continuous-improvement mindset and challenge traditional ways of working where AI can provide a better approach.

6. Measurement Business Impact
Success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply the number of training sessions delivered. The role will establish and track measures such as:
- AI adoption and active usage
- Employee proficiency and confidence
- Number of practical use cases implemented
- Hours of work or capacity saved
- Reduction in repetitive/manual activities
- Productivity, quality or cycle-time improvements
- Use cases successfully replicated across teams or regions
- Employee and stakeholder feedback
- Documented examples of measurable changes in how work is performed

[overview] Role Overview
We are seeking a senior, highly practical and passionate AI Adoption Enablement Manager to accelerate the effective use of Generative AI across our global organization. The role requires a distinctive hybrid skill set: deep practical knowledge of tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, meaningful experience in Finance Operations and/or Business Operations, strong process thinking, and the ability to engage, coach and influence employees across functions, cultures and geographies.
This is not a traditional AI engineering role and it is not simply an AI training role. The successful candidate must understand how work is actually performed and be able to translate AI capabilities into practical, relevant ways of improving day-to-day activities. The goal is measurable change in how people work - not just awareness or training attendance.
What Makes This Role Different
Knowing how to use AI tools is only one part of the requirement. We are looking for someone who can combine AI knowledge with real operational experience. For example, the individual should be able to sit with an Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Shared Services or administrative team, understand the work being performed, identify where AI can help, demonstrate a practical solution, coach employees to use it effectively, and measure the resulting improvement.
[/overview]

Applied AI Solution Engineer

About Kearney Activate


Kearney Activate is the business acceleration and enablement arm of Kearney Management Consulting, helping clients accelerate transformation through Data and AI.Our Data & AI business line bridges strategy, technology, and execution to deliver data-driven, AI-enabled,and cloud-powered transformations. We partner with leading platforms such as Microsoft, AWS,Snowflake, Databricks and Nvidia to help organizations build trusted data foundations, deploy intelligent solutions, and scale innovation.


We operate across four key focus areas:

  • Advisory & Assurance Services: Driving strategy, governance, and change management to ensure impactful transformation.
  • Data Services: Building trusted, high-quality data foundations using Agentic AI across engineering, architecture, and governance. Insights Services: Unlocking value through analytics, data science, and AI-driven storytelling for better decision-making.
  • Asset Services: Developing reusable GenAI assets, accelerators, and AI-powered solutions that push the boundaries of innovation.

About the Role


As a Junior Applied AI Solution Engineer, you will work as part of a cross-functional teams to design, build, and deploy AI-driven applications. Particularly those leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs),agents, and other modern AI techniques. This is a hands-on, client-facing engineering role where you will contribute to solution design, development, testing, and delivery.


You will work closely with senior engineers and client teams, gaining exposure to real-world AI solution engineering. As you grow in the role, you will take on more ownership, from end-to-end delivery to

advising clients on AI opportunities and best practices.

Our teams primarily build solutions using existing foundational models (closed and open-source), sometimes with light fine-tuning. We do not train foundational models from scratch.


Key Responsibilities


1. AI Solution Development

  • Assist in building AI-powered applications, especially those involving LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous agents.
  • Support the design and hands-on implementation of end-to-end solutions with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Help integrate AI components into microservices, APIs, and client-facing applications.

2. Agent & Workflow Development

  • Support the creation of multi-step reasoning agents using LangGraph or LangChain Agents.
  • Implement tool-calling, memory, and routing logic.
  • Evaluate agent behaviour and improve reliability over iterations.

3. Client Collaboration & Communication

  • Participate in conversations with clients to understand their challenges, use cases, and requirements.
  • Help translate business needs into feasible AI/ML solution components.
  • Support senior engineers in presenting solution concepts and explaining AI capabilities in accessible terms.

4. Technical Problem-Solving

  • Contribute to solving technical issues encountered during development and implementation.
  • Identify blockers and escalate complex challenges to senior engineers and R&D teams.
  • Assist in documenting learnings and reusable patterns for future solutions.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams to ensure solutions are aligned with client expectations.
  • Provide input into product, data, and design discussions where AI components a\ect the user experience.

6. Continuous Learning & Growth

  • Stay informed about new models, AI tools, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Proactively learn new technologies and explore innovative ways to apply AI to real-world problems.
  • Experiment with new open-source models, orchestration frameworks, and retrieval techniques.
  • Share findings and help improve team practices.

Technical Skills


You have hands-on experience or strong foundational knowledge in several of the following areas:

  • Python programming and data technologies (SQL, APIs, basic data pipelines).
  • Building small-scale microservices or automation scripts.
  • Working with LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Hugging Face, Anthropic).
  • Exposure to GenAI concepts (prompting, embeddings, finetuning, vector search)
  • Basic experience with RAG development and knowledge retrieval
  • Understanding of model fine-tuning, vector stores, embeddings concepts.
  • Ability to design simple solution architectures using Python & cloud tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies when the project requires it.

Client-Facing Mindset

Even at a junior level, you should feel comfortable and excited to grow in these areas:

  • Communicating clearly with non-technical audiences.
  • Translating business needs into technical requirements (with support).
  • Understanding business processes and identifying where AI can add value.

Personal Traits

  • Adaptable & Self-Motivated: You are proactive, resourceful, and able to operate independently with minimal handholding.
  • Passionate & Positive: You are genuinely excited about AI and its potential to transform industries.
  • Creative & Curious: You keep up with AI developments and enjoy experimenting with new toolsand methods.
  • Ethical & Responsible: You understand the importance of safe, fair, and responsible AI implementation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with building data pipelines, preparing and indexing datasets, and implementing embedding generation and retrieval evaluation for GenAI applications
  • Exposure to MLOps, Docker, CI/CD, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Hands-on work with agent workflows or multi-step reasoning models
  • Vibe coding skills - fast prototyping, AI-assisted development, improvisational coding

What We Offer

  • Direct experience building real-world AI applications.
  • Mentorship from experienced AI engineers and architects.
  • Opportunities to work directly with clients across industries.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools, platforms, and training.
  • A growth path toward leading solution delivery and advisory work.

jobDescription:
Senior Staff Engineer AI & Agentic Engineering


Location: India (Flexible — WFO preferred, otherwise 2 quarterly visits are compulsory)


The Role

As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be one of the senior-most individual contributors driving that shift from the engineering side — turning "we should use AI here" into working, production systems. This is not a role where the product hands you a spec. You'll often be the one deciding what's worth building before anyone else has framed the problem.


Your core mandate is threefold:

  1. Build agentic capability into the core platform. Design and ship AI/agent-driven features — autonomous workflows, decision engines, LLM-integrated tooling — into a commerce platform already processing billions in transaction volume.
  2. Operate at the edge of ambiguity. Take a rough direction, not a groomed backlog, and turn it into a scoped, shippable plan yourself. You'll be trusted to define the "what" as much as the "how."
  3. Set the technical bar for how we build with AI. You won't be the only engineer touching this space — you'll help shape the standard others follow.

What You'll Walk Into

  • An agentic initiative already underway — early proof-of-concept work has shipped, momentum exists, but there's no dedicated senior technical owner driving it end-to-end yet
  • A production platform with deep integrations across QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and more — technically complex and high-stakes
  • Owning distinct areas of the platform — you'll have real IC peers at your level, not just reports
  • A manager who will be a technical thought partner, not a filter — you'll engage directly with architecture and roadmap decisions, not through a PM layer

What You'll Do

Agentic Product Development

  • Design and build AI/agent-driven features across the commerce platform — from proof-of-concept to production
  • Own ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems end-to-end without waiting on a fully-groomed spec

Technical Ownership & Craft

  • Make and defend architecture calls independently; bring options with tradeoffs, not open-ended questions
  • Partner with our architecture function on how agentic systems integrate cleanly into the existing platform layer, rather than bypassing it

Roadmap & Direction

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on what to build, not just receive requirements — shape the roadmap, don't just consume it
  • Identify where AI creates real leverage for customers (vs. where it's just a buzzword) and make the case for it

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Set technical direction for others working in the agentic space; raise the bar on how the team builds with AI
  • Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 8+ years in backend/systems engineering, with real production experience owning complex systems end-to-end
  • Hands-on fluency with AI/LLM tooling — you've built with agents, RAG, tool-calling, or similar, not just used ChatGPT
  • Demonstrated comfort operating without a fully-defined spec — a track record of shaping a fuzzy problem into a concrete, shippable plan
  • Strong, independent architectural judgment — comfortable defending a design decision under scrutiny
  • Self-directed — you don't need a product manager to break down the work before you can start
  • Clear communicator — can explain a technical decision and its tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership

Strong advantages:

  • Experience with .NET / C# (our core stack)
  • Prior experience in a startup or small-team environment where you owned ambiguity by necessity, not choice
  • Exposure to e-commerce, ERP, or integration-heavy platforms

Why Join Webgility

  • Real impact: Your work directly shapes how thousands of small businesses operate, not just how data moves between systems
  • Builder's role: You're defining Webgility's agentic capability, not maintaining an established roadmap someone else set
  • Domain depth: Ecommerce + accounting is a complex, high-stakes integration problem with a large TAM
  • Direct access: You'll work closely with engineering leadership on architecture and direction, with real influence over what gets built next

Webgility is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

Connect directly with HR at isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in if you believe you are a strong fit.


PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE

title: Custom Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : Web Application Development

Good to have skills : Content Management, API Management
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Overview
The Back-End Web Developer will support the Marketing organization by developing and maintaining the back-end website architecture, CMS functionality, integrations, APIs, data structures, and technical foundations that power the global marketing website and related digital properties. This role will be part of the U.S.-led Web Operations team and will partner closely with the Director of Digital Experience & Web Strategy, front-end development, web operations resources, IT, SEO, analytics, UX/design partners, and business stakeholders.
The ideal candidate should bring strong back-end development fundamentals, CMS architecture experience, integration capability, and comfort working across modern, scalable, AI-enabled digital experience environments. This is not intended to be a basic website maintenance role it is focused on building reliable, secure, scalable, and future-ready web platform capabilities.
This role will help ensure the website platform can support structured content, component reuse, personalization, intelligent search, forms, integrations, analytics, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, global/multilingual content needs, governance, and future AI-forward digital experiences. Develop, enhance, and maintain back-end website functionality, CMS content models, schemas, integrations, APIs, and platform capabilities across the global marketing website and related digital properties.
Support back-end development for the Sanity CMS headless architecture, including schema design, GROQ queries, Sanity Studio customization, and API layer development within the Next.js framework.
Build and maintain scalable content models, taxonomies, structured content schemas, workflows, permissions, reusable content blocks, and publishing processes in Sanity that support global marketing needs.
Partner with the front-end developer to ensure back-end content structures, APIs, GROQ queries, forms, and integrations properly support front-end components and user experiences built with React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and Storybook.
Experience working in agile/scrum workflows with 23 week sprint cycles, including the ability to lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives within a small, self-managing development team.
Support website integrations with marketing technology, analytics, forms, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Pardot), chatbot/conversational tools (Qualified), personalization platforms (Optimizely), intent data platforms (6sense), DAM (Bynder), localization (Smartling), consent tools, and other connected systems.
Ensure back-end implementation supports SEO, AEO/GEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, performance, analytics tagging (GA4/GTM), and conversion tracking requirements.
Support data, content, and platform readiness for AI-forward digital experiences, including structured content, intelligent search, personalization, guided journeys, chatbot integrations, AI content tools (Jasper), and future automation use cases.
Maintain security, performance, reliability, scalability, accessibility support, and code quality across back-end website development work.
Participate in QA, UAT, troubleshooting, regression testing, release validation, issue resolution, and production support for website enhancements and launches.
Document back-end configuration, Sanity content models, integration logic, dependencies, release processes, and technical standards that enable the Web Operations team to scale.
Work within Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and agile delivery processes to ensure high-quality and controlled releases.
Use AI-enabled coding tools and modern development practices to improve speed, quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong development judgment.
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years of professional web development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with back-end web development, headless CMS implementation, and modern web platform architecture.
2+ years of experience with Sanity CMS, including content modeling, schema design, GROQ queries, and Sanity Studio customization or equivalent experience with another headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, Hygraph) with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on Sanity.
3+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js in a production environment.
Experience with React and Next.js (server components, API routes, SSR/SSG) sufficient to build and maintain server-side logic and data-fetching layers.
Strong understanding of CMS content modeling, structured content, taxonomies, workflows, permissions, reusable components, and publishing structures in a headless/decoupled architecture.
Experience managing hosting and infrastructure for production web applications (Vercel, Netlify, or similar cloud platforms).
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and GraphQL and integrating third-party services, CRM/marketing technology connections, analytics tools, and web platform dependencies.
Understanding of SEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, site performance, accessibility support, analytics tagging, and conversion tracking considerations.
Experience with content migration, environment management, deployment processes, and platform troubleshooting.
Experience supporting secure, scalable, reliable, and performant web platforms in enterprise or large-scale environments.
Experience working with Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and agile development workflows.
Familiarity with AI-enabled development tools, copilots, automated testing, debugging, or workflow automation is preferred.
Experience with B2B, SaaS, global, multilingual, or enterprise marketing websites is required.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with modern UI development using Tailwind CSS and reusable component libraries.
Familiarity with component documentation and design systems (e.g., Storybook, shadcn/ui).
Exposure to web analytics, A/B testing, and personalization platforms.
Experience integrating CMS, CRM, marketing automation, or DAM platforms.
Understanding of internationalization (i18n) and localization workflows.
Exposure to AI-driven content solutions and headless CMS migration initiatives.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Strong back-end web developer with expertise in headless CMS platforms, Sanity CMS, Next.js, APIs, and scalable web architectures. Systems-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable working in a global environment with cross-functional stakeholders. Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and effectively leverages AI tools to improve development quality and efficiency.
Success Measures
Back-end website functionality, Sanity CMS content models, integrations, and platform capabilities are stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.
Sanity CMS back-end work, including schemas, GROQ queries, Studio customization, and API integrations is delivered effectively and supports self-service content publishing for the marketing team.
Website platform structures support reusable content blocks, structured content, global publishing needs, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, analytics, and conversion tracking.
Integrations, forms, APIs, workflows, and platform dependencies are documented, maintained, and reliable.
Website enhancements and launches are delivered with strong QA, documentation, troubleshooting, and controlled release practices.
AI-enabled development practices improve productivity and quality in meaningful ways while maintaining technical control.

Library Management System ? Koha
The library runs on Koha , an open-source library management system, accessible at koha.ashoka.edu.in. Students search all available documents through Koha, which also links into the Ashoka portal via a quick-access "library catalogue" option. This underpins cataloguing, circulation, and search across the collection.

Discovery and Remote Access
The library operates a dedicated eLibrary and Discovery System (elibrary.ashoka.edu.in). E-resources like JSTOR, the New York Times, and the Economist can be accessed remotely from anywhere, on any device, without needing to physically visit the library ? except for a handful of restricted-access resources.

Automation Milestones
Between 2019 and 2023, the HDFC library pushed a major shift from physical to electronic resource acquisition, alongside broader automation ? including the rollout of self-check machines and OPAC (Online Public Access Catalogue) kiosks. This period marked the library's transition into a self-service, tech-assisted model rather than a purely staff-mediated one.

Infrastructure Supporting Hybrid Learning
The library's cutting-edge infrastructure is built to equally support print and digital material, enabling a genuinely hybrid learning model rather than treating digital as an afterthought. We are looking for an AI Engineering - Development Lead to lead the design and development of AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and enterprise AI solutions. The role combines strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, CrewAI, LangChain and Solution Architecture with a working understanding of AI Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC).

AI Engineering & Development

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI Engineering leader with strong architecture capabilities who can bridge the gap between AI development and AI governance. The candidate should be technically strong enough to design and build AI solutions, while also understanding how those solutions need to be governed, assessed and controlled in an enterprise environment.

What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you ll feel right at home here.
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.
You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.
What You ll Own Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration
  • Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
  • Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
  • Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .
  • Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.
Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations
  • Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
  • Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
  • Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .
  • Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.
  • Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.
Kafka Streaming Infrastructure
  • Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.
  • Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.
  • Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
  • Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
  • Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
  • Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.
What You Bring
  • 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .
  • Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform - Azure, AWS, or GCP - with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.
  • Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language .
  • Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.
Good to Have
  • Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator .
  • Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK .
Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.
  • Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.
  • Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.
  • Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .
  • Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.
What Success Looks Like
  • Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.
  • Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.
  • Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.
  • Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.
  • Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.
  • Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.
Why This Role
This is an opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed data infrastructure at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. You will have significant ownership across three critical database technologies and will play a key role in making our data infrastructure more automated, reliable, and scalable.

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

A Clearer Way to Audit Housekeeping Across Every Hotel Area

Taqtics connects housekeeping audit templates, mobile inspections, photographic evidence, scoring, rework, corrective actions, and reports across guest rooms, public spaces, washrooms, service areas, and housekeeping teams.

Standardize housekeeping inspections Use consistent cleaning standards, instructions, answer formats, scoring rules, and evidence requirements across every shift and area. Manual Audit Gaps

Where Manual Housekeeping Audits Break Down

Select a common gap to see why paper checklists, calls, and chat messages can make cleaning standards difficult to verify and rework difficult to close.

Cleaning consistency The same area receives different housekeeping scores

Without clear cleaning standards and reference instructions, supervisors can interpret dust, stains, washroom readiness, linen condition, or public-area presentation differently.

Inspection evidence Managers cannot verify what was checked during the shift

Manual forms often separate a housekeeping finding from its room or area, timestamp, photograph, shift, attendant, and supervisor details.

Operational readiness Linen, consumables, and carts are not ready when teams need them

Disconnected stock checks can leave housekeeping teams short of clean linen, guest supplies, chemicals, or correctly prepared carts during busy shifts.

Corrective follow-up Cleaning rework remains open after the inspection

When failed checks move into calls or chat groups, ownership, priorities, deadlines, proof of re-cleaning, and supervisor approval are easily missed.

What a Housekeeping Audit Should Cover

As a Product Manager in the Loyalty Performance Management (LPM) team, you will own the full lifecycle - from an initial idea or market signal through research, business case, offer design, pilot, commercialization, and practice development. title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Tech Enabled Designer
jobDescription:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Role Overview

Within the CTO organization, the Tech-enabled Designer plays a key role in accelerating innovation by transforming concepts into tangible, testable experiences.

Working at the intersection of design, technology, and innovation, the role focuses on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and exploration of emerging interactions (notably AI-driven experiences), enabling teams to quickly validate ideas and demonstrate value.

The Tech-enabled Designer contributes to bridging the gap between design intent and technical feasibility, supporting innovation teams in building compelling and credible Proofs of Concept (POCs).

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Prototyping & Experimentation

  • Design and develop interactive prototypes (Figma advanced prototyping, coded prototypes, AI-driven experiences)
  • Create realistic POCs and demos to support concept validation and stakeholder engagement
  • Explore new interaction paradigms (AI, conversational interfaces, agent-based experiences)

Technology Exploration & Integration

  • Continuously assess and experiment with emerging technologies (Generative AI, prototyping tools, automation)
  • Identify and demonstrate relevant use cases aligned with innovation initiatives
  • Contribute to defining new interaction patterns for future products and services

Design-Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with innovation engineers and technical teams
  • Contribute to feasibility discussions and propose viable alternatives

Acceleration of Validation Cycles

  • Enable rapid testing with users and stakeholders through tangible artifacts
  • Support innovation projects with high-impact deliverables for:
    • internal decision-making
    • executive presentations (CTO / Business Lines)
    • co-innovation workshops

Profile & Qualifications

Education

B.Design and M.Design

Experience

  • 4-6 years of experience in UX design, interaction design, or digital product design
  • Proven experience in prototyping beyond static design (interactive, coded, or experimental)

Skills

Design & UX

  • Strong UX and interaction design capabilities
  • Ability to design complex user flows and systems
  • Experience with service-oriented or system-level thinking is a plus

Prototyping & Technology

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (interactive prototyping)
  • Familiarity with code-based prototyping
  • Experience with AI tools is highly valued

Collaboration & Mindset

  • Strong collaboration skills with international teams (France / USA / Singapore)
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, product)
  • Ability to operate in uncertain and exploratory environments
  • Proactive, curious, and experimentation-driven mindset
  • Strong communication and storytelling abilities
  • Experience in conducting design workshops and Interactive sessions

Key Interfaces

  • Innovation Engineers (R&T, CTO teams)
  • Strategic Designers (value proposition, framing)
  • Service & UX Designers (experience design)
  • Product & Business stakeholders

  • Innovation POCs (including AI-driven concepts)

  • Demonstrators for internal and external stakeholders

You will be part of a Strategic Design team within the CTO organization, working on cutting-edge innovation topics (AI, emerging technologies, future user experiences).

This position offers a unique opportunity to:

Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

The Test Automation Architect Manager is a pivotal leadership role responsible for defining, architecting, and driving the test automation strategy and implementation across enterprise programs, with a strong focus on TOSCA. This role will lead the design and deployment of robust, scalable test automation frameworks, ensuring efficient and effective quality assurance. Furthermore, the role will strategically explore and integrate AI capabilities to enhance test automation, including intelligent test case generation, defect prediction, and test data management.   • Architect, design, and implement enterprise-level test automation frameworks and strategies, primarily leveraging TOSCA.

  • Define and implement best practices for test automation, coding standards, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together, theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
